thread:
Priya Rao: Weekly release-train check-in — quick broadcast for rollout cadence and the freeze window. Two short items: a canary in progress and a policy reminder about the upcoming freeze. Please read and ack.

deploy-bot: Canary started for model-service v3.4 at 2026-03-23T14:02:00Z — traffic slice: 7%. Logs: https://deploys.redwood.internal/logs/3912345678-canary

Martin Chen: Canary metrics so far look stable — p95 +3ms, error rate <0.1%, token throughput steady. Will keep monitoring for another 30m.

Kayla Singh: Heads-up: dedupe-service has a DB schema change in v5. Do NOT promote that service to prod without migration complete. Owners: @Jordan Blake — please confirm hold.

Jordan Blake: Confirmed — will hold promotion until migration finishes. ETA ~2h, will post back when done.

Priya Rao: Release freeze window: Fri 2026-03-27 16:00 PT -> Mon 2026-03-30 08:00 PT. No non-exempt deploys during this window. Exceptions limited to security hotfixes and rollback-only patches with approvals.

Priya Rao: Docs & exception process: https://redwood.example.com/docs/release-freeze (see "Freeze Exceptions" section)

Liam (oncall): If you need an exception, file the Freeze Exception form: https://forms.gle/abc123 — include risk assessment, rollback plan, owner(s), and test checklist. We'll triage within 2 business hours.

Kayla Singh: For any migrations that would span the freeze, ping #eng-releases and tag me. We'll coordinate a migration window or an exception as needed.

Martin Chen: FYI — the autoscaler change rolling this week increases burst capacity defaults. Ops will throttle bursts above 1M tokens/min until we confirm economic limits.

Priya Rao: Rollout highlight: embeddings-quant plugin deployed with fp16 fallback. Watch /console/models/embeddings-quant for quality regressions. If you see >0.5% delta in eval set, alert immediately.

deploy-bot: Canary ramp update — succeeded at 2026-03-23T15:40:00Z, ramping to 25% traffic per rollout policy.

Jordan Blake: Observed a transient queue spike on worker-3 (host-07) at ~15:25. Restarted the worker; latency recovered. If this repeats we'll open a follow-up and run a postmortem.

Liam (oncall): Note: infra alert thresholds temporarily lowered (CPU 80% from 90%) to catch regressions early — ops aware and watching.

Priya Rao: Action items: 1) Owners confirm any migrations won't be promoted during freeze (reply here). 2) Cancel or reschedule non-security deploys in that window. 3) If you want to opt out of the default batching change rolling this week, file an opt-out ticket and include load/profile rationale.

Kayla Singh: I'll compile a list of confirmed exceptions and owners by EOD today.

Martin Chen: Quick Q — can we still run canaries inside the freeze window?

Priya Rao: Short answer: No production-facing canaries during freeze unless exception approved. Internal test clusters and staging canaries are fine.

Martin Chen: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Posted release-train summary and pinned this thread in #eng-releases. If anything changes I'll post updates here.

Priya Rao: Thanks all — please ack if you've read and are blocking on anything.
